reviews.review_text: Sultan's Dine in Gulshan is one of the best places in Dhaka for authentic and flavorful Kacchi Biryani. I have dined here multiple times, both with family and alone, and every visit has been a great experience. The biryani is rich, aromatic, and perfectly cooked, with tender, juicy meat and well-seasoned rice. The portion sizes are generous, making it worth the price. The restaurant has a clean, elegant ambiance, creating a comfortable dining experience. The service is excellent, with friendly and attentive staff ensuring quick and efficient service. I recently visited again, and the quality remains top-notch. Apart from Kacchi, their other dishes are also delicious and well-prepared. If you're looking for the best Kacchi Biryani in Gulshan, Sultan's Dine is the perfect place. Highly recommended for food lovers!

If you're craving flavors and a hearty meal with friends or solo, this popular local dining space is that. Fragrant rice, tender meat, delish potato and the perfect blend of spices that make their kacchi unforgettable. But the experience doesn't stop there! Pair your kacchi biriyani with Jali Kebab and a glass of refreshing Borhani to balance the richness. This combo is a match made in foodie heaven. What makes this place stand out as foodie? ✔ Clean and welcoming environment ✔ Budget-friendly pricing ✔ Consistently delicious flavors Only downside is maybe, peak time service gets a bit slow.
They have limited but very tasty biryani options . I tried mutton biryani. Mutton was cooked perfectly it was tender and juicy. Also chiken Roast was good

I recently visited Chef's Table and had an absolutely wonderful experience. The restaurant offers a wide variety of dishes, each prepared with fresh ingredients and presented beautifully. The ambiance is modern yet cozy, making it perfect for both casual meals and special occasions. The staff were friendly, attentive, and made sure everything was perfect throughout the visit. The prices are reasonable considering the quality of food and service. I highly recommend Chef's Table to anyone looking for a great dining experience.

This is one of my favourite spots to hang out. It really offers something for everyone, whether you're after a quick snack or a full meal. The area is kept clean and well-maintained, providing a comfortable atmosphere to relax in. I'd certainly recommend it to others.
Clean food court. There are many food stalls. Prices are higher but quality is better than other food courts. Not extraordinary but good. Coffee shops, juice bar, and asian cuisine could be found.

𝗢𝘂𝗿 𝗘𝘃𝗲𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗮𝘁 𝗪𝗼𝗼𝗱𝗵𝗼𝘂𝘀𝗲 𝗚𝗿𝗶𝗹𝗹, 𝗕𝗮𝗻𝗮𝗻𝗶 🥩 Seven of us decided to try out Woodhouse Grill in Banani last night, and here's the honest scoop about our dinner! 𝗙𝗶𝗿𝘀𝘁 𝗜𝗺𝗽𝗿𝗲𝘀𝘀𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀 The restaurant has this nice, cozy feel to it. It's trying to give off that Western steakhouse vibe, and they do a pretty good job at it. Just a heads up - it can get pretty loud when it's busy. 𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗪𝗲 𝗔𝘁𝗲 & 𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝗜𝘁 𝗪𝗮𝘀 • 𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗦𝘁𝗲𝗮𝗸𝘀 (Brisket.Full ৳5,084): The star of the show! They were juicy and cooked well. When they bring it to your table with that smoke effect (Smoke Mate Jug - ৳4,445), it's pretty cool to watch. The meat was tender and flavorful - definitely what you'd hope for in a good steak. • 𝗦𝗼𝘂𝘁𝗵𝗲𝗿𝗻 𝗖𝘂𝗯𝗲𝘀 (৳585): These appetizers were a hit at our table. Small, tasty bites that got us ready for the main course. Worth trying! • 𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗦𝗶𝗱𝗲𝘀: • Mashed potatoes were smooth as silk and perfectly creamy • Mexican rice had good flavor • BBQ sauce complemented everything nicely 𝗗𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗸𝘀 Nothing fancy here - just your regular drinks like coke, sprite, fanta etc., water, and some local options like Mojo. They were cold and refreshing, which is what matters! 𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗣𝗿𝗶𝗰𝗲 Let's be honest - ৳21,255 (with VAT) for seven people isn't cheap. But here's the thing: the portions are big, the food is well-prepared, and for a special dinner out, it feels worth the money. You definitely won't leave hungry! 𝗚𝗼𝗼𝗱 𝘁𝗼 𝗞𝗻𝗼𝘄: • The portions are generous - good for sharing • If you want pictures, the smoke presentation is your moment • Try to come when it's less busy if you want to have a good conversation • The service is friendly and helpful

The atmosphere of this place and the service is second to none in Bangladesh. Amazing service, and the interior made me feel like I was in an old Western movie. I ordered the sirloin steak with mashed potatoes and Mexican rice. The steak was cooked perfectly medium rare, and the sides were great too. However, I felt the steak could have been better seasoned, and the fat cap should have been rendered better. For the price, I expected perfection, and I must say I've had better steak at lower prices in other places in Dhaka. Great place to go to with a group of people, whether family or friends, and if you've got the money to spare; but if you're looking for the best steak in town, I would look elsewhere.

Had their east Texas style t bone 250g It was juicy but a bit chewy. Maybe because it was rare (no medium rare on east style) (1001 taka offer) Their large sized sprite and coke was way too much for one person 😭 big mistake from my part Garlic coleslaw and Mexican rice was mvp side dish for me. Mashed potato was, just felt like a potato and mushroom was just spiced mushroom. Service was hella nice

They took too much time, but they were really professional and handled the situation really good. The portion was really good, but the food was quite meh (we were a big group and for this they hurried our food so they couldn't cook properly- as their statement). One of my friends told me their food is good, that's why I am putting 4 stars. I would expect better from next time. [Meal type: Lunch, price range ৳200–400, Food 4, Service 4, Atmosphere 5]

I had heard a lot of good reviews about this place, so I decided to try it a few days ago. I ordered their pizza, which was really good and reasonably priced. I also tried the Cox's Lemon, but I didn't enjoy it as much. Overall, it was a good experience, but I think the staff could be a bit more professional and improved in service. [Meal type: Dinner, price range ৳200–400, Food 5, Service 3, Atmosphere 4]

Went to Chillox in Banani and ordered the beef double decker burger (very spicy and loaded with mayo), along with fish tots, spicy French fries, and fried chicken. The burger was good, the spice level was spot-on and enjoyable. It got pretty messy while eating (as expected with all that mayo), but overall it tasted really good. The fish tots were a highlight, really nice, especially paired with their white yogurt sauce. This combo feels like probably the best finger food option at Chillox right now. The spicy French fries were also very good, and crispy. However, the downside was the fried chicken. It was not flavorful and felt very dull. Not up to the mark compared to the rest. Service was good, and the ambience is very nice too. The inside is well-maintained and clean overall.

Congested place with lovely interior specially washroom is really good and well maintained. Food is good, i think spice should be a lil less in french fries, or they can ask before adding it.children Can't consume this much, other wise everything is nice.food delivery is also fast despite of heavy rush. Baby sit is available
Food was good. And service also. A cozy place to chill with friends and family. Fun fact is they don't wet their burger with sauce and mayo like before 😭

Pretty place, pretty overpriced. We ordered- •Luchi Alurdom- 8/10. For the price they should include atleast 1 protein item in the dish or atleast increase the amount of alur dom and fruit chaat. The luchi was fried fresh, so that was good. •Khuder Bhaat- 8/10. Again, I felt for the price point they should include a protein item ,but the taste of every other item they did serve was good. The amount of the bhrotas were ridiculous, as you can see in the photos. •Komola Shundori-(Orange Iced tea) 9/10. •Coconut blend- 9/10. We asked for a straw and that the server replied that they don't use straws here. But, as you can see in the picture, when I ordered the iced tea they definitely do have metal staws but she just randomly refused to provide us. Well, for me, the main thing that stood out was the clear health code violation by having cats roaming around the rooftop restaurant. But then again nobody really cares about stuff like that in BD. They should also get better ventilation and more comfortable seating arrangements. Its an aesthetic gimmicky place and if you intend to go there make the most of it by taking alot of pictures. Hope this helps. Enjoy!

I went for Thursday Open Mic programme which is start from 8 Pm and finished around 11. But I left the place early. Lots of Bengali food they served. Good ambient for seating and hangout. Little bit noisy. Not smoking area is top of the roof corner.
Food tastes great. All the items were very good. Speacilly mussels were very tasty. Paella rice is perfect as well. Service was fast and friendly. Good for both family and casual dining.

A very sunny and open place for all types of sea food lovers. However their drinks are a little too sweet. When I brought this issue up with them, they instantly apologised and told me they would look into it

The Thai fish and chips was tasty, the sauce on top had a nice light and lemony taste. The tartar sauce however did not really taste like anything. Fries were well seasoned. The chicken Caesar salad was extremely good and fresh, loved the taste, best I had so far. A solid 10/10. I would like to point out that there's a huge number of staff for the small amount of customers they have. You will usually catch the staff staring at you while you're eating and it made us feel very uncomfortable the whole time. We left very quickly after finishing our food.

EXCELLENT! Kacchi Bhai in Gulshan is a hidden gem when it comes to authentic kacchi. The restaurant has a large spacious seating arrangement, which makes it perfect for both family gatherings and solo dining. Their Kacchi is outstanding—signature Kacchi Bhai taste with juicy mutton and perfectly cooked rice. The flavor profile is rich and aromatic. I also tried their meat rezala-style dish, which was rich, flavorful, and absolutely delicious. The staff are courteous and the service is prompt. Highly recommended for kacchi lovers. [Meal type: Dinner, price range ৳200–400, street parking]
Awesome. But serving was quite late. [Food 5, Service 5, Atmosphere 5]
